title: The plan of the Learning Cards
description: The index of the Learning Centre (DEC-LR-02, DEC-LR-25, TR-LR-01): the Learning Levels, their sections and every topic, written or still to write. A topic is written when it has a folder cards/<number>/ next to this file.

levels.description: The Compass, the four Learning Levels from easy to advanced, and the Reading Cards, in the order the Learning Centre shows them.

name.description: A name in the sense of the language principle: the same in both languages (NFR-LOC-01).

step.description: How far along the way it is, from easy to advanced.

icon.description: The icon of its audience, a name from Phosphor (DEC-UX-62).

sections.description: The sections of each Learning Level, in their order.

topics.description: Every topic, in the order of its section. Its Learning Level is the one of its section.

title.description: In English, as the card is written, and the Dutch of the master learning plan.

priority.description: How much the card matters, shown only as Suggested (DEC-LR-18). Every topic of a Learning Level has one; the Compass and the Reading Cards have none.

thinking.description: What the reader can do afterwards. Every topic of a Learning Level has one.

buildsOn.description: The topics it builds on, from the prior knowledge of the master learning plan.

note.description: Why the topic is there, when Data Hub added it to the master learning plan.

text.description: A text in both languages: English, as written, and Dutch (DEC-LR-24).
